roles.use_summary: Used PLINK for several separate genotype workflows: an ancestry-specific 1000 Genomes LD panel for GWAS-summary imputation; MVP genotype QC and sex checks; ROSMAP sample/variant QC and IBD relatedness; and staged FACS-MG QC, LD pruning and genetic PCs. The LD panel reports --ld-window-kb 1000000, --ld-window 1000, --maf 0.01 and --ld-window-r2 0. FACS-MG reports --indep-pairwise 1000 10 0.02, followed by 50 5 0.02.
roles.required_caution: Preserve each cohort and sequence of filters. MVP/FACS-MG HWE less-than wording does not unambiguously specify retention versus exclusion; do not invert it silently. ROSMAP explicitly excludes HWE P<1e-6 and reports IBD pi_hat>0.1875; KING 0.0884 is a separate coefficient. The first FACS-MG pruning argument is not explicitly labeled kb. Version and detailed LD-statistic flags are unstated. Imputation, EIGENSOFT projection, run_imputez and S-PrediXcan are separate.

roles.use_summary: Used PLINK 1.90b5.3 --clump to select independent GWAS variants with P=5e-8, r2=0.01 and a 10-Mb window. Subsequently merged lead SNPs within 100 kb, retained the smallest-P lead, annotated nearby protein-coding genes using bedtools and excluded HLA.
roles.required_caution: The later 100-kb lead-merging step differs from the 10-Mb LD-clump window. The stated P threshold does not establish both --clump-p1 and --clump-p2. Bedtools annotation, HLA exclusion and downstream enrichment are separate. Existing native clumping is related functionality, without a claim of complete 1.90b5.3 option or numerical parity.

roles.use_summary: Used explicitly named PLINK (v.2.0) to calculate ancestry PCs after MAF>=0.01, HWE P>=1e-10, variant missingness<=0.01, high-LD-region exclusion and LD pruning with a 1000-kb window, step 10 and r2=0.2. The later EUR set uses autosomal biallelic variants, imputation R2>0.8, HWE P>=1e-6, missingness<=0.02 and ancestry-specific ALFA MAF>=0.01. PLINK 2 also computes AD PRS from separately estimated PRS-CS-auto weights, including and excluding APOE.
roles.required_caution: This is explicit release 2. BCFtools merging, QDA ancestry assignment, ALFA annotation and PRS-CS estimation are separate. Do not assign PRS-CS priors/MCMC settings to PLINK scoring. Exact/approximate PCA and score allele/column/normalization/missing-dosage options are unstated.

Separate training/test/validation GWASs and additional European-test GWASs supplied the PRS portability comparisons.
